question: Identify the synonym of 'Clarity':
solution:
The correct answer is: **Lucidity**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Clarity"** refers to the quality of being clear, understandable, and free from ambiguity or confusion. (स्पष्टता)
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher explained the concept with such clarity that everyone understood it immediately.
 
 
• **"Lucidity"** is a synonym for clarity, meaning the quality of being easily understood or expressed clearly. (स्पष्टता)
 
 
• **Example:** The lucidity of her writing made the complex topic easy to grasp.
